slides.title: From Transactional Contact to Real Relationships
bullets: The industry is moving away from product-cycle-driven engagement
Toward relationships sustained over years with genuine mutual value
Not activity that spikes around a launch and fades afterward

slides.title: How Transactional Engagement Damages Trust
bullets: Intense activity before and after launch, then a sharp drop-off
Revived years later when a new indication creates fresh urgency
Experienced KOLs notice when engagement tracks the commercial calendar
It wastes the compounding value a real long-term relationship builds

slides.title: What a Longitudinal Relationship Looks Like
bullets: Starts from what the expert actually needs over their whole career
Sustained regardless of where a product sits in its lifecycle
Continued meaningful dialogue even in a year with no new data
Supporting a rising star's research before it touches any product

slides.title: Value-Based Means Genuine Reciprocity
bullets: Frequency of contact alone is persistence, not real strength
Value can mean access to unpublished data through proper channels
Or connections to other researchers and investigators
Or simply consistently excellent, well-prepared scientific dialogue

slides.title: The Connective Thread of This Module
bullets: Extends accurate identification, segmentation and a deliberate plan
Requires discipline to keep investing during quiet periods
Builds the trust that makes every future scientific exchange more valuable

takeaway.title: Longitudinal, value-based relationships replace transactional, launch-driven engagement
bullets: Sustained scientific dialogue must continue outside the launch cycle
Real value must be reciprocal, not just frequent contact
This discipline is the connective thread across every skill in this module
